title: Frame/legacy parity checklist — true loop station landed, tool and budget bars stay open for later stations

acceptance.detachedLoop: agent.prompt answers immediately with turnId, then streams outside the write gate; TrueLoopEmitsMultipleSlicesAndDone
acceptance.multiSlice: three gateway slices arrive as three text.delta events with one text.done carrying the full length; TrueLoopEmitsMultipleSlicesAndDone
acceptance.retryEcho: same caller requestId replays the same turnId with a single turn.started; SameCallerKeyReplaysSameTurn
acceptance.reentryGuard: second prompt on a running session fails TURN_IN_PROGRESS with a non-empty hint; SecondPromptWhileActiveReportsInProgress
acceptance.providerAuth: gateway 401 maps to turn.failed with reason PROVIDER_AUTH; ProviderAuthFailureMapsToFrozenReason
acceptance.networkFail: transport failure maps to turn.failed with reason NETWORK_FAIL; TransportFailureMapsToNetworkFail
acceptance.singleTimeout: single-call stall maps to turn.failed with reason TOOL_TIMEOUT, isolated from the whole turn; SingleCallTimeoutMapsToToolTimeout
acceptance.backpressure: backpressure failure maps to turn.failed with reason RATE_LIMITED; BackpressureMapsToRateLimited
acceptance.budgetGuard: denied budget ends the turn with RATE_LIMITED before any gateway traffic; BudgetExceededStopsBeforeGateway
acceptance.noWholeTurnCap: a slow turn completes with turn.done and no failure branch; SlowTurnCompletesWithoutWholeTurnCap
acceptance.historyTailLatency: twenty history reads beside a running turn stay under 200ms at the tail; HistoryReadsStayFastBesideARunningTurn
acceptance.cancelFastest: agent.cancel answers fast with signaled true while the loop emits turn.cancelled; CancelStaysOnTheFastestPath
acceptance.emissionCodes: PROVIDER_AUTH, NETWORK_FAIL, TOOL_TIMEOUT and RATE_LIMITED each fire at least once across the loop suite
acceptance.repairHints: tool repair hints keep business shape for the planner loop; RepairHintsStayBusinessShaped
acceptance.rollback: gateway handle off keeps the synchronous echo path; all echo-path suites stay green with no gateway configured

history.note: session.list/get paged read matches legacy; workspace-scoped, no silent full scan (inherited, still green)
history rows carry id, tool calls, tokens and reasoning; loop persists assistant rows with usage tokens
session.delete removes child sessions too — scheduled with the cutover station
list/get filter by workspace, no silent full scan; loop resolves the workspace per descriptor
frame page maps to render messages (inherited, still green)
prompt echo plus matching turn.done settle and incremental catch-up (inherited, still green)

tool.note: loop emits deferred tool.start/tool.end placeholders with role=tool rows; real dispatch lands with the tool station

turn.note: agent.prompt and agent.retry both run the detached loop with live deltas when the gateway handle is set; echo path unchanged when it is off
single-turn cancel stays on the fastest path; tree cancel lands with the cancel station
turn.failed carries the frozen reason set: PROVIDER_AUTH, NETWORK_FAIL, TOOL_TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMITED

usage.note: loop records real input/output tokens per round; budget bar wiring lands with the settings station
